Package dev.ucomprotocol.spi

Interface CheckoutAdapter

public interface CheckoutAdapter
Adapter interface for checkout session operations (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout).

Implement this interface to connect to a commerce platform's checkout flow.

    • completeCheckout

      default Checkout completeCheckout(String checkoutId, Checkout.Ap2Data ap2)
      Completes a checkout session with optional AP2 cryptographic mandate metadata (dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate).

      By default, delegates to completeCheckout(String) when not wrapped by AP2 enforcement.

      Parameters:
      checkoutId - the unique identifier of the checkout session
      ap2 - the AP2 mandate payload submitted by the platform/agent, or null
      Returns:
      the completed checkout session
